messages:
maria: did anyone else miss the alert for db-replica-2 ~10m ago? I only saw it in the repo but no pager.
aj: yup missed it here too. I saw the PD event in the web UI but no page.
pagerduty-bot: Alert delivered -> FAILED (delivery_delay=9m) for incident INC1234567; retry scheduled.
samir: I'm seeing a bunch of 'delivery delayed' spikes in our PD webhook logs. looks like provider-side queuing.
priya: PD status shows 'degraded delivery' in their incident feed: https://status.pagerduty.com/incident/2026-03-delivery-lag :/
leo: are we getting duplicates or ack failures too? we had one duplicate on the last page.
aj: duplicate came through after retry. the initial page didn't arrive, then retry fired and we got both in ~2m window. messy for oncall.
oncall-bot: @maria is now acknowledged oncall for incident thread 1764123456 (automatic handoff).
maria: switching to manual paging fallback. I'm enabling our twilio fallback webhook for high-sev alerts.
samir: command to trigger fallback (internal ops):
```
curl -X POST https://ops-internal.example.com/webhook/twilio-trigger
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
  -d '{"incident_id":"INC1234567","summary":"DB replica down","priority":"P1"}'
```
priya: good. I'm also opening a ticket with PD support, linking logs, and requesting ETA on retry backlog.
support-bot: support ticket created PD-7890 linking our webhook logs and sample payloads.
leo: quick customer impact check: which customers would have missed pages? Dedicated tenants with alert forwarding = yes. Hosted customers using webhooks only unaffected.
maria: confirmed — two Dedicated customers (acme-corp, nucleus) reported delayed incident awareness via support threads. no customer-facing downtime; only paging delay.
aj: can we post a brief internal status in #general and update the runbook? customer comms may be needed if PD ETA > 30m.
samir: adding an entry to incidents: cause: third-party pagerduty delivery delay; effect: delayed pages & duplicates; mitigation: manual SMS via Twilio, PD support ticket, monitoring toggled.
priya: oncall handoff note: if this persists through shift change, do a direct phone escalation for P1s. manual escalation numbers are in the runbook.
oncall-bot: Reminder: when using fallback, add tag `fallback:twilio` to the incident for postmortem correlation.
maria: PD support just replied: "We're experiencing a backlog due to internal delivery queueing, retries are being throttled. Working on recovery, ETA ~18-24m."
aj: timeline seems reasonable. we should keep manual fallback enabled for next 30m and taper off once PD confirms recovery and backlog drains.
leo: note for postmortem: track duplicate suppression — maybe add dedupe window in our oncall-bot to collapse retries within 3 minutes.
samir: temporary workaround: update oncall-bot to ignore duplicate alerts with identical fingerprint within 180s. I can push a patch.

// samir pushes a quick change to the bot (log snippet):
```
// oncall-bot dedupe
if (alert.fingerprint == lastFingerprint && now - lastSeen < 180000) return; // drop duplicate
```
```
// deploy: ops-automation triggered deploy 1764123802 -> success
```

priya: PD status updated: "Recovery in progress; delivery queues clearing."
maria: I'm turning off the Twilio fallback for non-P1s. keep it on for P1 until PD clears backlog.
aj: can someone update the incident channel with a short summary for the exec on-call?
leo: summary draft: "PagerDuty experienced delivery delays which caused delayed and duplicate pages. We enabled Twilio SMS fallback for P1s, opened PD ticket PD-7890, patched dedupe in oncall-bot. No customer service downtime observed; two Dedicated customers reported delayed awareness. Monitoring added; follow-up postmortem planned."
maria: posted to execs and #incidents-summary.
support-bot: PD support confirmed backlog drained at 1764124050; root cause: internal queue saturation during a config rollout.
priya: turning off fallback for all severities now.
maria: quick checklist of action items before we close: [ ] postmortem, [ ] add PD latency alert, [ ] add internal webhook healthcheck, [ ] dedupe window config in oncall-bot (permanent), [ ] review paging runbook.
aj: I'll take PD latency alert. samir will own dedupe. priya will compile postmortem.
leo: closing notes: customers notified where appropriate. nothing to escalate to legal/compliance.
maria: thanks team. closing thread once postmortem draft is in the docs folder. :thumbsup:
